entries.title: Shorigan
entries.description: A philosophy developed through story and tested against reality. Shorigan has two aspects — a Living Philosophy and a Living Story — each feeding the other.

documents.title: Shorigan — The First Tome
documents.description: Living the Surreal Dream. Fifteen chapters on the three Eyes, Living Honour and Legacy, Fear as a friend, the philosophy of action, and the Living Bones a life is built from.

documents.title: The Shorigan — The Eye of Integration
documents.description: First Manual for the Newly Awakened. An instruction manual for a way of paying attention: the two Eyes, the Five Principles, a working compendium of techniques, and a thirty-day initiation.

documents.title: A Red Book, and a Red Cappuccino
documents.description: A standalone novella of the Shorigan cycle. Alexander asks Isor for permission to meet Anansi, and learns what a story costs when it is not offered for free.

documents.title: Away From Home — Chapter One
documents.description: A parallel chronicle of the Shorigan cycle. "The Names We Keep From Ourselves" — Anna Bell has built her life around never letting anyone speak her true name.

documents.title: Away From Home — The First Verse
documents.description: A later anchor chapter of Away From Home. In a room that exists nowhere, Anna Bell finds Alexander coming quietly apart — and reckons with the part of it that is her own fault.

entries.title: Infinite Story Engine
entries.description: An attempt to build a system that generates continuous narrative while keeping a human firmly in the role of author and editor. As much a study of where that role breaks down as a product.

entries.title: Media Production Engine
entries.description: A working pipeline for producing finished media with mixed human and machine steps, built to make each hand-off visible and each decision attributable to a person.

entries.title: Song of the Fallen
entries.description: A piece of narrative work connected to Shorigan, written and published as interactive fiction. Currently on hiatus — more words are coming. Its process — the drafts, the cuts, the forks — is recorded in the development log.
